method: Read policy, build branch, preview handlers/frame loop, focused tests, renderer topology; inspected relevant working diff. No tests/build/browser run by reviewer. Root reported68tests is DOCUMENTED_ONLY here.

findings.problem: Off-map x/y are not bounds checked before flattened fog indexing. x=-1 or x=map.width can alias a valid neighboring-row fog entry, causing an outside-map pointer site to be classified topology allowed/blocked instead of unknown.
findings.reproduction: For width64, preview x=-1,y=1 reads visible[63]; if that in-map cell is visible, an invalid off-map preview appears visible. Candidate policy accepts finite off-map coordinates because map bounds intentionally belong to authority.
findings.impact: Misleading topology preview only; authoritative build bounds guard still rejects outside-map commands before costs/orders.
findings.recommended: Require integer x/y within0<=x<width,0<=y<height before fog indexing; invalid coordinates yield visible=false/unknown.

Focus tests cover candidateT/cross, neighbor thirdbranch, construction reservation, dead/enemy/embarked/off-grid exclusions, untouched unrelated junction, no spend/order/nav/entitymutation.
